kind.description: location, argument, parameter, result or global.

address.description: VA of the instruction, call, function or global.

function.description: The function and offset, null for a global.

location.description: The register or slot (for arguments and parameters: at the callee's entry), null for results and globals.

values.description: The answer: distinct values (backward) or API arguments reached (forward), over the whole graph.

items.description: A distinct value reaching the seed (backward), or an API argument or switch case the seed's value reaches (forward).

kind.description: const, string, function, address, import, api_result, sink, or switch (the case a constant selects).

address.description: VA, for strings, functions and addresses.

nodes.description: Nodes of this page, in discovery order.

items.description: A node: a value (backward) or a use (forward).

kind.description: seed, const, address, string, function, import (pointer of an imported function), api_result, call_result, parameter, global, field ([base+off] load), stack_local, merge (paths with different values), loop, unknown; forward: argument (into a callee of the image), sink (argument of an API or unresolved callee), store, field_store, return, compare, switch, dereference, call_target.

address.description: VA of the defining or using instruction (the function for parameters, the global for initial contents).

image.description: The loaded image Address is in when it is not the seed's (reached through an import or export).

location.description: Register or slot, when the node has one.

text.description: The value or use as text (quoted strings, names, decoded constants).

value.description: The number, for constants and compares (hex).

valueAddress.description: The address the value is: string, function, global (VA).

decoded.description: The value named by the API parameter or return it meets (GENERIC_READ|GENERIC_WRITE, WAIT_TIMEOUT).

depth.description: Function boundaries crossed from the seed.

parent.description: The node it was reached from (-1 for the seed).

direction.description: backward (a value reaching the seed) or forward (a use of the seed's value).

derivation.description: The instructions it came through, or why it is unknown.

edges.description: Edges with either end on this page.

items.description: A data-flow edge, From's value flows to To.

kind.description: copy, merge, loop, field, use, argument (caller's argument to a parameter), parameter (into a callee), return, store, load.

site.description: The call, store or load instruction (VA), when the edge crosses one.

frontier.description: Unexplored items, each with its follow-up call.

reason.description: depth, functions, nodes, callers, writers, readers or steps.

offset.description: Index of the first node on this page.

truncated.description: More nodes follow (call again with offset).
